sloka: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा वानराणां ततस्ततः।कुम्भकर्णेन सुग्रीवं गृहीतं चापि वानरम् ।। ६.६७.७३ ।।
transliteration: vidrutāṁ vāhinīṁ dṛṣṭvā vānarāṇāṁ tatastataḥ।kumbhakarṇena sugrīvaṁ gṛhītaṁ cāpi vānaram ।। 6.67.73 ।।

translations.english: Then Kumbhakarna, an enemy of Indra, who was equal to Indra in heroism seizing Sugriva, the Indra of monkeys, who is equal to Indra, thought, 'If Sugriva is killed it is like killing all the army including Rama.'
